correctness.rationale: Conservation gives P(t)=m+st-M(t) and E=mT+sT^2/2-int_0^T M. Exact stage formulas Mout=u_r Min+s z_r and stage integral=z_r Min+s(h-z_r)/r show the entire supply-dependent permutation term is s*z_a*z_b*z_c*r_middle. Strict cumulative hazard comparison eliminates dominated outer pair orders. Direct signed candidate gaps (a-b)z_a z_b (s z_c-m) and (b-c)z_b z_c (m-s z_a) prove all five regimes and ties; no additional optimizer is possible since positivity/distinctness make eliminations strict. With two stages the supply term cancels, so three is minimal. Independent exact rational tests of three rate triples and five loading regimes corroborate.

value.rationale: Distinguishing integrated receiving-pool stock from terminal wash-off makes the order-dependent supply effect a natural mathematical question; two sharp thresholds and middle-rate independence yield a complete nontrivial three-stage classification and a meaningful minimality contrast to two stages. This is a toy linear model, not empirical risk guidance.

final_claim: In M′=s-k(t)M, P′=k(t)M with m,s>0 and three distinct k-values a>b>c>0 each for equal h>0, the six orders are sharply classified by initial-loading ratio m/s: maximizing order (b,a,c) for m/s<z_c, (a,b,c) for m/s>z_c, tie at z_c; minimizing order (b,c,a) for m/s<z_a, (c,b,a) for m/s>z_a, tie at z_a, z_r=(1-e^-rh)/r.
